canonicalEntities.name: Conversation
canonicalEntities.role: CANONICAL omnichannel conversation thread (status/priority/channel/mode AI|HUMAN|PAUSED, unreadCount, assignedAgent, queue). Singleton-open per (workspaceId,contactId,channel) via raw partial unique index. Owns Message[]. This is the customer-facing inbox conversation.

canonicalEntities.name: Message
canonicalEntities.role: CANONICAL omnichannel message (direction INBOUND/OUTBOUND, type, content, mediaUrl, status SENT/DELIVERED/READ/FAILED, externalId for provider idempotency via @@unique([workspaceId,externalId])). The real customer-message store written by InboxService.saveMessage inside a $transaction.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelMessage
canonicalEntities.role: LEGACY brain conversation message (role/content/metadata per workspace). De-facto canonical for brain dialog history. Aliased by MindMessageService; raw table still the read/write target behind the Mind facade. NOT yet migrated to RAC_MindMessage.

canonicalEntities.name: ChatMessage
canonicalEntities.role: CANONICAL dashboard/thread chat message (threadId FK -> ChatThread, role/content/metadata, soft-delete deletedAt). Written by KloelThreadService.persist{User,Assistant}ThreadMessage and chat.service. Aliased by MindChatMessageService.

canonicalEntities.name: ChatThread
canonicalEntities.role: CANONICAL dashboard chat thread container (title/summary/summaryUpdatedAt, owns ChatMessage[]). The UI-facing assistant-conversation grouping. Distinct from Conversation (inbox) — different surface entirely.

canonicalEntities.name: KloelConversation
canonicalEntities.role: LEGACY lead-funnel conversation log (leadId FK -> KloelLead, role/content/intent/sentiment/metadata). Per-lead sales dialog. Written by saveLeadMessage in kloel-lead-processor-helpers + lead-mind-coordinator. The one legacy message surface most recently bridged to MindMessage (source:'lead_conversation').

canonicalEntities.name: MindMessage
canonicalEntities.role: INTENDED-CANONICAL unified message table with source discriminator ('brain'|'dashboard'|'lead_conversation', also 'thread'|'channel' written by code). DESIGNED to subsume KloelMessage+ChatMessage+KloelConversation+Message. CURRENTLY CANONICAL-BUT-DEAD: only flag-gated (KLOEL_MINDMESSAGE_DUALWRITE, default OFF) writers, ZERO readers (state-builder reads .items which resolves to prisma.kloelMessage, NOT mindMessage).

canonicalEntities.name: FbMessage
canonicalEntities.role: Facebook/Messenger-specific message (mid, senderPsid/recipientPsid, pageId, deliveryStatus, raw webhook metadata, @@unique([workspaceId,mid])). Channel-native ledger written ONLY by FacebookMessengerService (backend/src/marketing/facebook-messenger.service.ts). Parallel to the canonical Message table for the same physical FB messages.

canonicalEntities.name: PartnerMessage
canonicalEntities.role: Affiliate/partner internal chat message (partnerId FK -> AffiliatePartner, senderId/senderType/senderName, readAt). Internal-partnership surface. Written by PartnershipsService + internal-partnership-dispatch.adapter.

canonicalEntities.name: AdminChatMessage
canonicalEntities.role: Admin copilot chat message (sessionId FK -> AdminChatSession, AdminChatRole enum, toolName/toolArgs/toolResult for tool-call trace). Internal-admin surface. Written by AdminChatService. Note: only model in cluster NOT using RAC_ prefix and using @map snake_case.

canonicalEntities.name: AdminChatSession
canonicalEntities.role: Container/thread for AdminChatMessage (admin copilot). The admin-surface analogue of ChatThread.

services.name: InboxService

services.name: InboxEventsService

duplications.concept: Unified message table (RAC_MindMessage) vs the 4 live source tables it claims to canonicalize
implementations: RAC_ChatMessage (schema:1899) — dashboard thread, REAL read/write target
RAC_KloelConversation (schema:1865) — lead funnel, REAL read/write target
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_MindMessage is the DECLARED canonical, but it is canonical-but-DEAD: every writer is gated behind KLOEL_MINDMESSAGE_DUALWRITE (default OFF) and there are ZERO readers (StateBuilder/KloelConversationStore read .items = prisma.kloelMessage). Until a backfill + read cut-over lands, the 4 legacy tables remain de-facto canonical per surface.
duplications.note: The intended end-state (one table, source discriminator) is sound and the dual-write scaffolding is consistent across all 4 surfaces. Risk: a half-migrated state where dual-write is ON but no read path consumes it => silent divergence + 2x write cost with no benefit. Treat as architectural-entropy until the read cut-over + KloelConversation/Message inclusion are real.

duplications.concept: Facebook/Messenger message persistence in TWO tables for the same physical message
implementations: InboxService.saveMessage -> RAC_Message (when FB routed through omnichannel)
duplications.canonicalChoice: RAC_Message (omnichannel canonical) should be the single conversation/message store; RAC_FbMessage should be a provider-native delivery ledger ONLY (mid/psid/deliveryStatus), not a parallel conversation history.
duplications.note: Two writers, two unique keys (Message @@unique[workspaceId,externalId] vs FbMessage @@unique[workspaceId,mid]). If both fire for the same FB DM the inbox UI (reads RAC_Message) and any FB-native consumer (reads RAC_FbMessage) can diverge on delivery status. Verify whether FB inbound is double-persisted.
